text: Investcorp's March 2026 corporate presentation (shareholder figures as of 31 December 2025) lists Mubadala, Abu Dhabi's sovereign wealth fund, with 20% of Investcorp's shares; the same presentation's board page lists Yasir Aqil Badri, Mubadala's vice president of financial services, as a member of Investcorp's board of directors.
short: Mubadala (Abu Dhabi's sovereign fund) holds 20% of Investcorp and a seat on its board.

source.name: Investcorp Corporate Presentation, March 2026 (PDF on investcorp.com)
source.quote: Investcorp Employees1 29% Mubadala 20% Other GCC Sovereign Entities2 33% GCC Merchant Families 18%
source.note: Ownership table on the slide headed 'Investcorp Ownership' (figures 'As of December 31, 2025'; footnote 2 notes three GCC sovereign shareholders). The next slide ('Supported by an effective, strategic, and accountable Board of Directors') lists Yasir Aqil Badri, 'Vice President, Financial Services, Mubadala', as a board member.

additionalSources.name: Khaleej Times: Mubadala to acquire 20% take in Investcorp
additionalSources.quote: Mubadala, Abu Dhabi state investment fund, will acquire a 20 per cent stake in Investcorp, a Bahrain-based alternative investment firm.
